notes.title: V.0.7.347.20250226
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Input Controller[/h2]
[list]
    [*]The game now supports input controllers.
[/list]

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Fixed the tutorial message issue.
    [*]Introduced a tutorial on the first join.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Shield added.
    [*]Bot added in the tutorial.
    [*]Balanced damage, fire rate, number of projectiles, and health for various classes.
    [*]Optimized class agility.
[/list]

[h2]Audio & Effects[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Activated chest sound.
    [*]Improved zoom ability for better accuracy.
[/list]

[h2]Bonus & Game Modes[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Drone now drops health.
    [*]Prizes awarded to the leaderboard winner.
    [*]Prize modified based on position in Royal Mode.
[/list]

[h2]Settings[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Added keyboard and mouse input action to settings.
[/list]

[h2]Thanks[/h2]
A special thanks to all the testers who actively contributed to improving the game.  
Your passion, attention to detail, and valuable feedback have helped us create a  
better and more balanced version. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Major Update: Tutorials, Weapon Balance & Character Adjustments!
notes.notes:
We’re continuously improving the game based on player feedback! Here’s what’s new in this update:

 - Enhanced tutorials to help new players learn faster
 - Weapon balancing for a more fair and competitive experience
 - Character ability adjustments to ensure a smoother gameplay

Jump in and experience the improvements firsthand!

notes.title: 🧠 Improved Bot AI in Survival Mode!
notes.notes:
he battle just got tougher! With this new update, bots in Survival Mode will behave more realistically and unpredictably.

🔹 Enhanced tactical behavior for enemies
🔹 Faster reactions to your actions
🔹 More intense challenge for experienced players
🔹 Strategic and deadlier enemy waves

🔥 Test your skills and see if you can still survive!

notes.title: 🏆 New Kill Leaderboard in Fast Game!
notes.notes:
Are you ready to prove you're the best? With the new Kill Leaderboard, every elimination matters! Compete against other players and climb the ranks to claim the title of top fighter.

🔹 Track your kills in real time
🔹 Climb the leaderboard and prove your dominance
🔹 Challenge your friends and beat your personal record
🔹 Show off your skills in Fast Game mode

🔥 Jump into the game now and reach the top of the leaderboard!

notes.title: Challenge the WaZzDonutz Record
notes.notes:
Join the challenge on Steam and try to beat the WaZzDonutz record! Anyone who surpasses the record will win 2000 Coins, equivalent to €20! Join us and put your skills to the test!
You have until Sunday at 23:59 CET to make it!

notes.title: Play Fast Royal Early
notes.notes:
Step into the world of Fast Royal, an innovative futuristic battle royale where advanced robots, nanotechnology-based upgrades, and fully destructible arenas await you!

This is your chance to experience the game early. Join our exclusive playtest on Steam and help shape the future of the game with your feedback.

✨ Key Features:

Total destructibility powered by Unreal Engine Chaos.
Unique upgrades for robots and weapons.
Epic multiplayer battles.
Three robot classes: Warrior, Assassin, and Tank.
🎮 How to Join:

Click 'Request Access' to join the playtest.
Download the game via Steam.
Get ready to fight and discover the next generation of battle royale!
🚀 When: Available starting today.
🔗 Where: Steam - Search for "Fast Royal Playtest"
